items.editor_note: DeepSeek Harness debuts as an open-source Claude Code rival, launching alongside V4-Pro API access at higher prices than V4-Flash.

editorial.tldr: DeepSeek open-sourced V4-Flash on Aug 3 as a leaner 304B model that beat its own V4-Pro preview and matched Claude Opus-4.8 on benchmarks. A week later, hands-on testing found the "better and cheaper" pitch held up, but not in the way the early benchmarks suggested.
editorial.whats_new: DeepSeek shipped its V4-Pro flagship on Aug 13 alongside DeepSeek Harness, an open-source coding-agent CLI positioned against Claude Code, and priced V4-Pro API access above V4-Flash.
editorial.why_it_matters: V4-Pro's higher API price breaks the "better and cheaper" cost assumption teams built around V4-Flash, and the open-source DeepSeek Harness is a self-hostable Claude Code alternative worth a look.
editorial.take_for_builders: Rerun DeepSeek cost estimates against V4-Pro's published API price before routing production volume there, and pull DeepSeek Harness for a quick side-by-side eval against Claude Code.

status.detail: V4-Pro is out with an agent-tooling push and a Claude Code rival, but at a higher API price than V4-Flash.
